values.note: RV site or electric tent site $30 a night for Duplin County residents, $35 for non-county residents; $3 off for military and seniors 62+ ($27 / $32). Non-electric tent sites $25, group camping $5 per person. The non-resident charge is by COUNTY residence. General admission ($3 resident / $4 non-resident per person) is for day use and 'does not include picnic shelter or camping'.

fees.source: https://www.duplinnc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/193/Cabin-Lake-Brochure-PDF ('RV Sites– DUPLIN RES. & Elec Tent $30.00 per night $27.00 Military/Senior Citizens (62 and older)', 'RV Sites—NON RES & Elec Tent $35.00 per night', 'Tent Sites (Non-Elec) $25.00 per night'; PDF modified 2026-03-02), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $3 a night off for military and for seniors 62 and older.

hookups.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CabinLakeCountyPark (the county's booking page; site amenity filters 'Electric 30amp', 'Electric hookup', 'Water hookup', no sewer), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The county's campground map numbers 14 sites in the RV area, 10 labelled RV and 3 labelled Tent, with pad lengths marked 34 to 67 ft.
The county books nightly sites on Firefly Reservations ('Make a reservation' on the park page); 'Reservations for camping and picnic shelter rentals are highly recommended.' Park office 910-298-3648.

booking.source: https://www.duplinnc.gov/184/Cabin-Lake ('Reservations for camping and picnic shelter rentals are highly recommended', 'Make a reservation' link) + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CabinLakeCountyPark, read 2026-10-22

note: Duplin County park on a 69-acre lake. RV, electric-tent, tent and group camping; swim beach (Memorial Day to Labor Day, Thursday-Sunday), canoe and pedal-boat rentals, fishing pier, 2.3-mile hiking trail; no gasoline motors on the lake, no alcohol. --Claude
summary: Priced from the county's 2026 brochure: RV/electric-tent $30 resident, $35 non-county resident, $3 military/senior discount; 30-amp electric and water per the Firefly booking page; showers on the map; reservable on Firefly. Note's '~$25/night' (the non-electric tent rate) dropped. Not stated: season, sewer, max rig length.
